_comment: Velodyne VLP-32C (HDL-32C / Ultra Puck) calibration shimmed into Ouster schema for COIN-LIO. Vertical FoV -25 deg (down) to +15 deg (up) with NON-UNIFORM spacing concentrated near the horizon (denser between -1 and +1). Angles below are ordered TOP->BOTTOM (ring 0 = highest beam). Source: Velodyne VLP-32C user manual / ros-drivers/velodyne VLP32C.yaml. VLP-32C fires lasers in groups so per-laser azimuth offsets exist (delta in deg) - filled in beam_azimuth_angles in the same top->bottom order. 10 Hz with 0.2 deg horizontal resolution => 1800 columns per frame.
